text:
Alex: Heads up - cloud marketplace partner OrionCloud changed SKU mapping for our Dedicated reservations. We have 3 reservations impacted: res-0a3f, res-0a40, res-0a41. ETA shifted ~3 weeks. cc @Liam @Kate

Liam: On it. Which regions are affected? any DC codes?

Alex: EU-west-1 and us-central. Partner sent a terse note, link: https://orioncloud.status/announcements/sku-consolidation

Kate: @Alex please paste the partner message here so we can see whether this is a supply shortage or a rename

Alex: Quote from partner: "SKU consolidation: ORN-GPU-32 -> ORN-GPU-32Q. Reservations auto-mapped but quota linking failed for some marketplace reservations; manual reattach required." Looks like a mapping + quota carryover bug.

Deploy-bot: reservation-sync job started for res-0a3f (job-id: job-992)

James: This will hit the joint customer launch next month if we lose capacity. Can we throttle the canary expansion to free capacity? @Sara FYI for launch comms

Sara: We can't postpone launch. Ops/infra - can you outline short-term mitigations? regional bursting, preemptible fallback, or swap partners?

Liam: Short-term plan: 1) ask OrionCloud to reassign quota to our org-id, 2) open manual reservation hold for the affected items, 3) start EdgeCompute pre-provision as a fallback. Created ticket with OrionCloud support: https://support.orioncloud/ticket/8872

Kate: Finance flagged invoice/SKU mapping concerns - the SKU rename might break billing reconciliation. @James can you loop in finance? We need to avoid wrong chargebacks to customers.

Alex: If Orion fails, EdgeCompute can cover ~60% capacity with ~2 week lead time (better than Orion's 3-week shift). Recommend kicking off EdgeCompute now.

James: Kick it off. I'll pause canary expansion and cap customer-facing throughput until capacity is stable. :thumbsup:

Liam: Update from Orion support: they re-linked res-0a3f and res-0a40 within the last hour. res-0a41 requires manual procurement approval (ETA ~48h). I'm pushing contact now.

Sara: Good progress. Kate/Finance: confirm billing path for swapped SKU so invoicing doesn't break. Alex: start EdgeCompute provisioning tasks but hold full cutover until we know res-0a41 status.

Deploy-bot: reservation-sync job completed: res-0a3f ✔, res-0a40 ✔, res-0a41 pending manual approval

Alex: Thanks - will keep this thread updated. If res-0a41 doesn't clear in 48h, we'll proceed with partial cutover to EdgeCompute and a soft-limit on canary.

Kate: Noted. I'll send a short note to finance and legal about the SKU rename and tracking IDs.

James: I'll update the launch risk register and the customer comms doc with the contingency plan.

Liam: Adding action items to partnership tracker: ticket 8872, edge-provision-req-55, billing-check-12. Will ping when procurement approves.

Sara: Great coordination. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when your action is started.
